caption:
It wasn't losing power.

It was hiding its light.

Above Earth, a colossal armored shell narrowed a cyan fissure until only a trace remained. Something out there had made even a giant afraid to be seen.

What was it hiding from?

Stay with the signal.

#ColossusSignal #CosmicHorror #SciFiMystery
first_comment: SIGNAL NOTE: The cyan light originates inside the dark armored shell. The plates are closing to conceal it—not opening to attack.
